name: @document-kits/epub-engine
description: The "epub"/"mobi" DocumentEngines, built on the package's own pipeline (zip-source/mobi parse → package/toc → resources/rewriter → sections → paginator). Byte/parse work runs in a per-book worker (pdf.js MessageHandler, fake-worker fallback); rendering, DOMParser and the blob-URL cache stay on the main thread — see docs/plans/2026-10-15-epub-worker-prep.md §7.
author: Priestch
